subject.title: fix(doctor): surface multi-account default routing warnings in preview and lint

question: Should `core/doctor/default-account-routing` be a default warning-level doctor lint check that returns nonzero for existing multi-account configs without explicit routing?
rationale: The code path and proof are strong, but AGENTS.md treats stricter validation and operator-visible config/default behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and this PR changes default lint results for existing operator configs.

options.title: Accept default lint warning
options.body: Merge once a maintainer explicitly accepts that these existing multi-account configs should fail warning-level doctor lint by default.

options.title: Make lint opt-in first
options.body: Keep the preview and repair-mode warning surfacing, but set the structured lint check default-disabled or only selectable until upgrade impact is clearer.

options.title: Ask for upgrade proof
options.body: Request broader operator/config sampling or docs guidance before deciding the default lint behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept default lint warning
recommendation.body: Merge once a maintainer explicitly accepts that these existing multi-account configs should fail warning-level doctor lint by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The default-account warning helper history and current-main blame make steipete the best available owner for the config/doctor compatibility choice.
